scope: Synthetic six-row same-age cohort; ten paired repetitions per CPU. Descriptive only; no population CI, page/Tika latency or production promotion.
resource_scope: Fields named full_arm are the recorded snapshot interval: CPU before is read after CLI setup/host admission; CPU after is read after model verification/load, all-session/selected-arm warmup, reference preparation, cohort, reporting and engine teardown, before remaining final snapshots/exit. memory.peak is the cgroup high-water mark at its read. This is not literal process lifetime.
interpretation_amendment: Clarifies scope only; all raw values and frozen protocol preserved.
